## [2.11.1](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/compare/v2.11.0...v2.11.1) (2026-11-14)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **wps:** make the master switch the first card and name it clearly ([1bf6aea](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/commit/1bf6aeaf249b06584ad9d063b4ce587041b8321e))

patches.name: Google sign-in via MicroG RE
patches.description: Makes Google sign-in work on a re-signed WPS by signing in as the original app. Needs MicroG RE installed with a Google account added. WPS account login is unaffected.

options.description: Tells MicroG the app's original name and signature, which is what makes Google accept the sign-in.
Points WPS's Play services calls at MicroG instead of Google.
MicroG fails Google's signature check, so this answers the availability check with yes.
Sends push notifications through MicroG so they keep arriving.
Makes both Play services packages visible on Android 11+, so sign-in can reach MicroG. Stock WPS declares neither, so leaving this on changes nothing else.

patches.name: Unlock premium features
patches.description: Opens the paid tools - PDF, export, editing, fonts and templates - by answering the app's payment checks. Every part has its own switch, so you choose what is unlocked. Sign in first: signed out, WPS reports no membership at all.

options.description: Answers every premium check with "yes". This is the switch that actually unlocks the app - the options below it only tidy up what it produces.
Shows your account as Premium, so upgrade banners and price cards go away.
Tells the app you have a Pro membership, which opens the menu entries locked behind it.
Answers "do I own this?" with yes, so premium fonts, templates and PDF tools open.
Tells the app you are ad-free, so banner and full-screen ads are never requested.
Stops the popup that says you are already a WPS Premium user.
Removes the "Upgrade to WPS Membership" banner shown above the tool pages. It can invent usage counters, so it stays off until you want it.
Answers every AI request as not owned. Use it only if an AI tool keeps loading forever.
Tells the app ads are off before it contacts the server, so those requests never start.
Only analytics reads this. It does not affect premium, ads or sign-in.

patches.name: Unlock AdGuard Premium
patches.description: Opens the paid features and removes the license prompts. The app then reports a lifetime family license, so no purchase screen appears.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks local premium tools and cleans up VIP labels.

patches.name: Hide playback controls at stream open
patches.description: Keeps playback controls hidden when a stream opens or the player switches between embedded and fullscreen. The controls remain available.

patches.name: Improve Android TV playback controls
patches.description: Helps the Android TV remote reveal native playback controls and focus the seekbar when available. Live streams may not be seekable.

patches.name: Remove configured startup and banner ads
patches.description: Suppresses configured startup/banner ads, the Telegram prompt and message ticker.

patches.name: Fix search keyboard focus
patches.description: Opens search on Android TV and helps keep the keyboard connected during category searches on TV and phones. Clears TV search on navigation or close.

patches.name: Hide playback controls at stream open
patches.description: Keeps playback controls hidden when a stream opens or the player switches between embedded and fullscreen. The controls remain available.

patches.name: Improve Android TV playback controls
patches.description: On Android TV, prefers the seekbar when controls open and helps retain focus when live-source tabs auto-focus. Seeking depends on the stream.

patches.name: Remove ads, proxy & restrictions
patches.description: Stops background bandwidth sharing, removes ads, and hides the player app logo on 7.4.

options.description: Hides the scrolling announcement/redirect marquee bar on Home and Player screens.
Skips optional and forced update prompts on Splash startup.
Blocks promotional push notifications and skips the notification permission prompt.
Allows running inside work profiles, app cloners, or alongside HTTP debugging tools.
Deletes unused proxy/ad libraries to save about 7.7 MB. Not needed for ad removal.

patches.name: Remove ads, telemetry & restrictions
patches.description: Removes ads, tracking, and forced updates, and keeps channels working after patching.

options.description: Disables PushService and Firebase Cloud Messaging, skips Android 13+ notification permission prompts, and removes notification permissions and receivers.
Skips forced update screens. With this on the app never updates itself — re-patch a newer stock version to update.
Bypasses root and sniffer-app lockouts. Only turn this on if the app refuses to run on your device.
Deletes unused libraries and tracking components to save space. Not needed for ad removal.
Closes the in-app web view so ads cannot open landing pages. Pages that legitimately use it, like score pages, will close too.

patches.name: Clean Me page
patches.description: Removes Status Saver, Legal, and Help from the Me page.

patches.name: Custom codec
patches.description: Bundles an MX Player custom codec; official v3.1.0_r1 codecs are verified.

options.description: Choose an MX Player v3.1.0 AIO ZIP, official ARMv7 or ARM64 ZIP, or a codec library. For an official single-ABI codec on a dual-ABI APK, the matching official companion is downloaded and verified during patching. An internet connection may be needed.

Allow an unrecognized codec only when it covers every input APK architecture. Its authenticity and decoding capabilities are not verified; use at your own risk. Automatic companion downloads work only for recognized official codecs.

patches.name: Remove ads & bloat
patches.description: Removes ads and online extras like Live TV, Tube, Shorts, and Games for a clean local player.

patches.name: Remove bottom navigation bar
patches.description: Removes the bottom navigation bar and moves Me to the top-right corner.

patches.name: AdBlocker turbo & userscript bundle
patches.description: Updates the built-in ad blocker automatically in seconds instead of minutes, and can add a shortlink bypass userscript.

options.description: Cloud downloads ready-made filters in seconds (recommended). Local Turbo builds them on your device, faster than stock. Stock leaves 1DM unchanged.
Installs and auto-updates a mobile shortlink bypass userscript. Keeps your on/off choice, and never returns if you delete it.

patches.name: Browser setup prompts only once
patches.description: Shows the one-time browser setup prompts only once, even if you close the browser early.

patches.name: Optimize cold start and battery
patches.description: Makes the app open faster, use less battery in the background, and stay in Recents when you press Back.

patches.name: Preset browser settings
patches.description: Sets Brave as the default search engine on fresh installs. You can change it anytime in 1DM.

options.description: Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Saved or imported choices are not overwritten.
Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Match uses the selected provider when 1DM supports it, otherwise None.
Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Brave and DuckDuckGo are not supported by 1DM for reverse image search.

patches.name: Remove ads and promotions
patches.description: Removes banner and popup ads, upgrade offers, and sponsored shortcuts.

patches.name: Enable premium
patches.description: Enables local premium status in Daylio 1.71.1. Account- or server-dependent features may not work; this is not a purchase.
